title: BOOT-04 single-host reassessment using the Duels reference

changes.description: Reassess October7 managed-service preference against the Director-supplied one-host Duels stack. Inspect accessible public pages, delivered JS, sanitized console/network signals and own guest bot turn/reload/cleanup; authenticated Codex session remains unreachable.

Prefer one Dokploy-managed NA host with local PostgreSQL and bounded processes, optional Redis/pooler, cached assets and off-host backups. Preserve full vision/authority/package boundaries; larger paid/HA footprints become conditional alternatives.
Record proposed ADR, dated provider semantics/rate retrievals, explicit costs/unknowns, observed source hashes/coverage/access limits and updated current recommendation/handoff.

Fresh baseline RUN001 passed existing-container doctor/static/docs/bootstrap5/read-only DB. RUN003 passes source/rate/arithmetic/scope/observation checks; RUN006 passes corrected final docs/history/secret/preservation checks. Failed attempts retained separately.

Documentation edit initially used generic status/evidence names instead of implementation_status/evidence_links and interrupted CSV output. Reconstructed all baseline rows plus the intended BOOT-04 update; correction verification then used an overwritten local variable and failed before comparing the right file. Final explicit-path comparison proves all32 task rows and unrelated values preserved. No application/private data affected.

RUN-20261008-002 retains a real static-check KeyError from using optional instead of source_optional. Earlier source/rate/cost assertions ran before the failure; no complete pass claimed. Source retrieval clock audit separately flags four discontinuous raw intervals, preserving wall/monotonic samples and body hashes.

RUN004 preserves a caller TypeError in sourceSecretScan after successful docs/static checks; privateRedactionValues returns an object. Correct only the invocation to Object.values, retaining the scanner and failed receipt.

RUN005 exited0 after corrected documentation/secret checks, but the recorder failed it for clock_changed. Review also identified over-escaped line/field splitting in its port probe; no listener proof is claimed. Preserve raw receipt/log; rerun proper TCP parsing with consistent clock samples, without changing the recorder or clocks.

RUN006 passes corrected final static/documentation/history/private-file/preservation checks with actual TCP parsing and consistent paired timing. Sanitized logs reviewed. Finalize only this research correction, keeping overall BOOT-04/provider/capacity/recovery acceptance pending.

Exit0 with clock_discontinuous/failure_reason clock_changed is not passing acceptance. Over-escaped port parsing also required correction; no actual listener proof claimed from this run.

Corrected final static/docs gates, current/full-history known-secret scan, unchanged executable fingerprint, ignored owner-only private files and actual15 kernel TCP rows proving no app listeners. Consistent paired clock; no provider/device qualification.

limitations: BOOT-04 remains in progress; no provider/budget/recovery/operations/domain selection or deployment.
